scope: Revision Journey only, with required navigation/model-contract additions
features: Horizontal data-driven roadmap and clickable, keyboard-accessible milestones
Event inspector with revision identity, actor/source, comments, timestamps and finding evidence
Support for draft creation, AI check, finding detection, revision creation, recheck, submission, approval and changes requested
V1/V2 and arbitrary preserved-version comparison with added/removed copy and targeting changes
Exact approved revision attribution independent of newer pending revisions
Navigation from Reviewer Detail and Content Check, plus links to exact full snapshots
Loading/error, empty journal, missing content/event/snapshot and unavailable/single/same-version states

dataProvenance.storage: Existing immutable revisions and decision journal; no new history store or hardcoded timeline
dataProvenance.recordedEvents: IDs, revision IDs, actors, comments and timestamps are read from the existing journal
dataProvenance.derivedMilestones: Missing creation/check/finding steps are derived from revision numbers and stored simulated findings, explicitly labeled At submission; no independent timestamp is invented
dataProvenance.emptyJournal: No historical milestones are fabricated when the event journal is empty
dataProvenance.ai: All AI-related findings are simulated; no compliance or cryptographic guarantees

adapter: Read-only RevisionJourneyService composes the existing queue adapter for content/submission ID resolution and reviewer-detail adapter for history reads/subscriptions. Real APIs can replace this contract without changing the UI.
comparison: Word/whitespace LCS with a bounded middle fallback above 250,000 matrix cells; preserves source text and Unicode; rendering never mutates snapshots.

liveValidation.reason: Frontend-only task; no real services or browser automation requested.

callCounts.note: Mock invocation counts are not instrumented; tests use local adapters.

cache.dependencies: Existing node_modules/npm cache reused; no dependencies added
cache.application: Existing in-memory session only; no persistent database/cache

limitations: Creation/check times were not stored in existing records, so corresponding inferred milestones are labeled rather than independently timestamped.
Visual fidelity, actual browser keyboard/scroll behavior and backend integration have not been verified.
Login and other screens were not implemented.
